description: This file defines the Response class within the Slim Framework PSR-7 implementation. It manages HTTP response messages, including status codes, reason phrases, and headers, and provides methods to manipulate and retrieve response details.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response message, including status code, headers, and body, following PSR-7 standards.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Response object with optional status, headers, and body.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Performs deep copy of headers when response object is cloned.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Returns a new Response with the specified status code and reason phrase.

methods.name: getReasonPhrase
methods.description: Retrieves the reason phrase associated with the status code.

methods.name: filterStatus
methods.description: Validates and filters the status code.

methods.name: filterReasonPhrase
methods.description: Validates and filters the reason phrase.
